release.content: pubkit 0.41.1 was released on 2026-11-16 from commit 218714c3219dad849c7a1f33fc99026284b13a95 with these changes.

rows: sync reads no compiled file as a template: pip compiles the seeded tests/steps/test_repository.py into a __pycache__ inside the installed package, which 0.41.0 then read as text and failed on (UnicodeDecodeError) in every repository's sync --check
pubkit gherkin no longer says every test is a Gherkin scenario when open exceptions waive a rule: it says how many are open, then lists them
